display_name: Awareness E14: Social media and oversharing (full episode)
description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for all staff. On an authorised exercise at Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional practice, you first play the red team: pin what one colleague's public posts give away, then write one message built from it. Then you swap sides, spot the same tricks in a feed and an inbox, and close the gaps on the profiles. Only the inbox is scored, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
